caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a hinged lid, shown in perspective so that both the front and left side are visible. The wood is colored in shades of brown, with the grain texture carefully rendered. The front panel features an engraved or carved swirling linear pattern stretching across its width, with additional small geometric motifs such as diamonds and a teardrop shape included in the design. There is a keyhole in the center of the front panel, slightly above the decorative pattern. Metal rivets or nails are visible along the left edge of the chest where the front meets the side. The letters "I" and "H" appear vertically aligned on the left edge of the front panel, and the letters "B" and "H" are present on the right edge, arranged horizontally. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background with a faint rectangular border sketched around the chest.
title: Bible Box
